an11.19:1.1: bhikkhū → bhikkhu (bj) | Tatra → M6 only has siyā bh- bhikkhuno tathā- samādhi-, then kasaṁñi assa, yam p'idaṁ diṭṭhaṁ sutaṁ viṁñātaṁ pattaṁ pari- anuvi- manasā, tatrā pi na saṁño assa, saṁñi ca pana assā ti, omitting also Nos. XXI, XXII. (pts note)
an11.19:1.3: bhikkhū → bhikkhu (bj) | Bhadante → M. Ph. bhaddante. (pts note)
an11.19:2.1: pathaviyaṁ pathavisaññī → paṭhaviyaṁ paṭhavisaññī (bj); paṭhaviyaṁ paṭhavīsaññī (sya-all, pts) | yampidaṁ → yamidaṁ (sya-all) | na → M. pa || na ākiñcaññāyatane. (pts note)
an11.19:4.1: pathaviyaṁ pathavisaññī → paṭhaviyaṁ paṭhavisaññī (bj); paṭhaviyaṁ paṭhavīsaññī (sya-all, pts) | yampidaṁ → yamidaṁ (sya-all) | pe → M. Ph. pa. (pts note)
an11.19:5.1: pathaviyaṁ pathavisaññī → paṭhaviyaṁ paṭhavisaññī (bj); paṭhaviyaṁ paṭhavīsaññī (sya-all, pts) | yampidaṁ → yamidaṁ (sya-all) | pe → M. Ph. pa; omitted by T. M7. (pts note) | idaṁ → Ph. S. yam idaṁ. (pts note) | tatrāpi → Ph. T. M7 tatra pi. (pts note)
an11.19:6.3: pathaviyaṁ pathavisaññī → paṭhaviyaṁ paṭhavisaññī (bj); paṭhaviyaṁ paṭhavīsaññī (sya-all) | na → M. pa || yam p'idaṁ. (pts note) | tatrāpi → Ph. M7 tatra pi. (pts note)
